scope: Independent Nebraska custodial packet pre-raster reread. The repaired four-document build, source roles, output glyph readings and manifest order were checked. Text44/Text46 courthouse location blanks and Text1/Text74 certificate fields remain participant supplied and are not prefilled. Visual clipping/overlap remains unmeasured pending central raster.

ROUTE_IDENTITY.finding: The custodial set-aside route agrees across source receipt, field map, wiring, manifest and participant guidance.

SOURCE_IDENTITY.finding: All four exact held source documents are present and bound by their committed content digests; source geometry/text was used for the four newly named DC-1:15 fields.

COMPONENT_SET.finding: The four declared components are built and ordered as CC-6-11, CC-6-11.2, DC-1:15 and CC-6-11A in both fixtures.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.finding: Current actual output preserves intended known case/caption writes and leaves unmatched county selections participant supplied. The newly surfaced Text44 county, Text46 floor, Text1 actual server and Text74 actual service date are not written; instructions identify each exact blank and required timing.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.finding: The guide discloses the required county, courthouse location, filing facts, notice and certificate completion work, including the four repaired plain-label fields.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.finding: Court type and route-dependent selections are preserved; no unsupported county or hearing choice is silently inserted.

REPEATING_ROWS.finding: The packet's repeating petition and charge structures remain present and the focused completeness run reports no incomplete rows.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.finding: Signatures, judge/court fields, service certification and actual mailing facts are withheld. Text1 and Text74 are specifically not prefilled because they certify who actually mailed notice and when it occurred.

ARTIFACTS.finding: Current canonical and boundary PDFs were hashed directly; the four-document build publishes output glyph readings and the focused completeness evidence reports 20/121 written with no packet-byte mutation after the repair.

PAGE_ORDER.finding: Both five-page fixtures preserve the actual manifest order CC-6-11, CC-6-11.2, DC-1:15 and CC-6-11A.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.finding: No local raster was created and no current central raster receipt is available.

FILING_DESTINATION.finding: Instructions identify Nebraska county or district court filing according to the sentencing court and direct confirmation with the clerk.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: The guide accurately describes the in-principle waiver route and does not claim an unavailable waiver form is included.

SERVICE.finding: District-court notice by mail and certificate completion are explained; county-court handling is separately stated, with actual service details left for the person who performs the act.

SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: The participant guide carries its court/practice and eligibility stop conditions and directs clerk or legal-help escalation where needed.
